title: The Epistemic Governor: Supplementary Figure Scripts and Calibration Data
description:
Supplementary figure generation scripts (Figures 1–5) and Fidelity Index calibration matrix for the manuscript: The Epistemic Governor: Reconceiving Professional Identity and Methodological Accountability in AI-Assisted Scholarship. Submitted to the International Journal for Educational Integrity (IJEI), AI-Ethics Collection (Springer Nature / BMC), 2026.

Contents:

  • figures/ — Five Python matplotlib scripts generating all manuscript figures at 600 dpi (BMC/Springer Nature combination artwork specification)
  • data/Epistemic_Governor_Calibration_Matrix_TableA1.xlsx — Complete calibration matrix with 15 individual Φ scores across three reference categories (Direct Extraction, Human Paraphrase, Stochastic Divergence) and Reference Implementation symmetric chunking comparison (Zhu et al. 2025)
  • scripts/generate_calibration_data.py — Reproducible data generation script

Calibration summary: Direct Extraction (n=5, M=1.00), Human Paraphrase (n=5, M=.58, R=.24–.82), Stochastic Divergence (n=5, M=.54, R=.35–.67). Reference Implementation: Φ = 0.5963 (≈ .60), below τ = .70 verification threshold. PCR Audit Engine: all-mpnet-base-v2 (Reimers & Gurevych 2019), 768-D sentence embeddings, cosine similarity. Source: PCR Master Execution Ledger, March 2026.

Note: PCR_Audit_Engine.py v6.0 is not included pending intellectual property review. See Appendix A procedural logic proxy in the manuscript for independent replication.
